milestone: EXP-P1 / Track 2 — Classify Provenance, the first occurrence of the classify-provenance N+1 shape. Recorded retroactively (2026-09-14) to satisfy this schema's requirement that every candidate-invariant occurrence cite a real, existing resolutionId — CI-2026-09-05-BATCH-PER-ITEM-SUBSTRATE-READS-BY-GROUPING-KEY-001's first occurrence named only a bare commit hash, which the validator (services/invariants/resolutionRecords.ts) correctly rejects as insufficient.
problem: The 'Run until you need me' feature (added 2026-09-03) made triageUnclassifiedProvenance call suggestClassification/resolveEvidenceSourceRef once PER unclassified invariant inside loadTrack2ProgrammeState's hot path, which runs on every Track 2 read. With 53 unclassified invariants live at investigation time, this meant 53+ sequential Supabase round-trips per read, causing a 15-second 'programme state composition' timeout.
observedFailure: The Research Copilot showed 'Classify Provenance — 53/58' with a working deep link at one point, then reverted to a timeout/degraded state on a later refresh — the symptom the operator reported before the root cause was traced.
rootCauses: resolveEvidenceSourceRef's read was scoped by each record's source-document signature (a grouping key), not the record's own identity — the 53 records collapsed onto a small number of distinct signatures, so 53 sequential reads were almost entirely redundant, but nothing batched them.
resolution: services/research/provenanceCohortPreparation.ts's batchResolveEvidenceSourceRefs now batches this into ONE discovery_evidence query across every invariant, preserving the same deterministic no-evidence/incomplete-lineage/repo-internal-citation triage output per record — verified against a live count (58 successor-scoped promoted invariants, 53 unclassified at investigation time).

components/composer/IRLResearchCopilotTab.tsx: the Copilot's remedy text already pointed at GET .../provenance-cohort; the cohort action was wired directly into the Copilot so clicking through worked end-to-end, not just the batched read.
